owner: existing A-share QFQ producer and single-stock candidate projection
rebuild_source_limit: The old copied five/ten-bar source remains defective; the repaired local rule has a distinct source, helper and contract identity and does not certify the complete prose strategy.
diagnostic_storage: one same-security, same-trading-date sidecar and bound view; no diagnostic columns added to panel roles

reused_columns.brick_count: kb_brick_consecutive; retain every persisted value, including seven legacy warmup rows; display UNKNOWN when sidecar kb_brick_count_reason is present
reused_columns.bowl_white: selector zge_white_line / backtest white_line, rounded to two decimals only when sidecar kb_bowl_components_status is OBSERVED_SOURCE_LINES
reused_columns.bowl_yellow: selector zge_yellow_line / backtest yellow_line, rounded to two decimals only when sidecar kb_bowl_components_status is OBSERVED_SOURCE_LINES

fixed_history: Two previously computed same-symbol/date candidates may be joined only after exact SHA, unique complete key, source generation, price-basis and full-prefix binding checks; no old label or OHLCV recalculation.
incremental: Reuse only with matching code/rule/price-basis/calendar and input prefix identity; otherwise calculate newly added, matured or affected revised rows using the same helper under the existing QFQ checkpoint and completion flow.
unknown: Keep insufficient history, invalid inputs and not-applicable states separate; never default missing to zero or false. Do not infer non-quantified anchors.
